description: This file contains unit tests for the CleanCSV class in the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing its methods for escaping characters and handling starting characters.

classes.name: CleanCSVTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functionality of the CleanCSV class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates an instance of CleanCSV before each test.

methods.name: testGetEscapeChar
methods.description: Tests that the getEscapeChar method returns the expected escape character.

methods.name: testGetStartingChars
methods.description: Tests that the getStartingChars method returns the expected list of starting characters.

methods.name: testEscapeField
methods.description: Tests that the escapeField method correctly escapes a given field.
